scripts.test: echo 'running tests (logged to ./results/test.log) ...' && forge test -v --gas-report | tee ./results/test.log | grep -v '^|.*|$' | cat -s && grep -A1 '^|.*|$' ./results/test.log > ./results/gas-report.txt && echo; yarn disabled && echo; yarn coverage && yarn contracts:sizes > ./results/contract-sizes.txt
scripts.test-old: forge test -vv --gas-report | tee ./results/test.log && grep -A1 '^|.*|$' ./results/test.log > ./results/gas-report.txt && yarn disabled && yarn coverage && yarn contracts:sizes > ./results/contract-sizes.txt
scripts.coverage: echo 'generating coverage (logged to results/coverage.log) ...' && forge coverage --report summary --report lcov > ./results/coverage.log && grep '\(-\|^| \(src/\|Total \|File \).* |$\)' ./results/coverage.log > ./results/coverage.txt && lcov --extract ./lcov.info --output-file lcov.info 'src/*' > /dev/null && echo 'done.'
scripts.coverage-old: forge coverage --report summary --report lcov | tee ./results/coverage.log && grep '\(-\|^| \(src/\|Total \|File \).* |$\)' ./results/coverage.log > ./results/coverage.txt && lcov --extract ./lcov.info --output-file lcov.info 'src/*'
